seaVertex: uniform float time;uniform float storm; varying vec3 vWorld; varying vec3 vNormal;float h(vec2 p){return sin(p.x*.13+time*.8)*.48+sin(p.y*.2-time*.65)*.3+sin(dot(p,vec2(.34,.25))+time*1.2)*.13;}void main(){vec3 p=position;float scale=1.+storm;p.z=h(p.xy)*scale;vec3 n=normalize(vec3((h(p.xy-vec2(.1,0.))-h(p.xy+vec2(.1,0.)))*scale,(h(p.xy-vec2(0.,.1))-h(p.xy+vec2(0.,.1)))*scale,.2));vNormal=normalize(mat3(modelMatrix)*n);vWorld=(modelMatrix*vec4(p,1.)).xyz;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*viewMatrix*vec4(vWorld,1.);}
seaFrag: uniform float time;uniform float light;uniform float storm;uniform vec3 boat;uniform float speed;varying vec3 vWorld;varying vec3 vNormal;float hash(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}float noise(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);return mix(mix(hash(i),hash(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x),mix(hash(i+vec2(0,1)),hash(i+vec2(1,1)),f.x),f.y);}void main(){vec2 p=vWorld.xz;vec3 n=normalize(vNormal+vec3(sin(p.x*2.8+time*1.8)*.07,0.,sin(p.y*3.9-time*2.)*.06));vec3 view=normalize(cameraPosition-vWorld);float fres=pow(1.-max(dot(view,n),0.),3.);vec3 reflection=reflect(-view,n);float clouds=noise(reflection.xz*5.+time*.004)*.6+noise(reflection.xz*13.)*.3;vec3 sky=mix(vec3(.21,.34,.4),vec3(.71,.77,.76),clouds)*light;vec3 deep=vec3(.025,.16,.20)*(.3+light*.7);vec3 col=mix(deep,sky,.22+fres*.78);vec3 sun=normalize(vec3(-.5,.3,-.8));float spec=pow(max(dot(reflect(-sun,n),view),0.),150.);col+=vec3(1.,.85,.58)*spec*.55*light;float dist=length(p-boat.xz);float foam=(1.-smoothstep(2.,5.,dist))*smoothstep(.45,.75,noise(p*3.-time))*.25*min(speed*.2,1.);col+=foam;float fog=1.-exp(-length(cameraPosition-vWorld)*.0015);col=mix(col,vec3(.43,.55,.59)*light,fog);gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.);}
skyFrag: uniform float time;uniform float light;uniform float storm;varying vec3 vP;float hash(vec3 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec3(127.1,311.7,74.7)))*43758.5453);}float noise(vec3 p){vec3 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);return mix(mix(mix(hash(i),hash(i+vec3(1,0,0)),f.x),mix(hash(i+vec3(0,1,0)),hash(i+vec3(1,1,0)),f.x),f.y),mix(mix(hash(i+vec3(0,0,1)),hash(i+vec3(1,0,1)),f.x),mix(hash(i+vec3(0,1,1)),hash(i+vec3(1,1,1)),f.x),f.y),f.z);}float fbm(vec3 p){float s=0.;float a=.55;for(int i=0;i<5;i++){s+=a*noise(p);p=p*2.03+vec3(7.);a*=.5;}return s;}void main(){vec3 d=normalize(vP);float y=max(d.y,0.);vec3 sky=mix(vec3(.58,.69,.71),vec3(.16,.32,.43),pow(y,.45));vec3 p=d*4.2+vec3(time*.006,0.,0.);float c=fbm(p+fbm(p*1.7));float mask=smoothstep(.38-storm*.08,.66,c)*smoothstep(-.03,.14,d.y);float shadow=fbm(p+vec3(0,.25,0));vec3 cloud=mix(vec3(.29,.36,.42),vec3(.91,.91,.83),smoothstep(.25,.67,shadow));sky=mix(sky,cloud,mask);vec3 sun=normalize(vec3(-.5,.3,-.8));float glow=pow(max(dot(d,sun),0.),28.);sky+=vec3(.25,.18,.08)*glow*(1.-mask);gl_FragColor=vec4(sky*light,1.);}
